DROP VIEW [EDS].[V_WMG_DEP_TRXNS]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [EDS].[V_WMG_DEP_TRXNS] AS WITH Rolling_Window AS
	(
	SELECT * FROM
		(
		SELECT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Business_Day_Flag ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC) AS RN
		,* 
		FROM eds.DATE_DIM
			INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
				--ON LEFT(FULLDATE,7) = LEFT(DATEADD(MONTH, -1,DEPOSITS_DATE),7)
				ON FULLDATE = '2024-10-25'
		WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
		) A
	)
    /*, PREV_DB AS
	-- UAT Workaround
	(
		SELECT  RW.FULLDATE, FORACID_UNMASKED, MAX(AS_OF_DATE) AS PREV_AOD
		FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT, Rolling_Window AS RW
		WHERE AS_OF_DATE < RW.FULLDATE
		GROUP BY RW.FULLDATE,FORACID_UNMASKED
	)
    */
	SELECT 
		RW.FullDate AS asofDate
		--,NULL AS modifiedDate
		,EDF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.orgkey AS [CIF NO]
		,EDF.ACCT_NAME AS accountName
		,EDF.FORACID_UNMASKED AS accountNumber
		,EDF_PREV.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS beginningBalance
		,coalesce(EDF.TRAN_DATE_BAL,0) - coalesce(AGG_LIENAMT, 0) AS availableBalance
		,HTD.TRAN_DATE AS transDate
		,
		--HTD.VALUE_DATE AS valueDate,
		HTD.TRAN_PARTICULAR AS particulars
		,(
			CASE 
				WHEN HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE = 'D'
					THEN TRAN_AMT
				ELSE 0
				END
			) AS debit
		,(
			CASE 
				WHEN HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE = 'C'
					THEN TRAN_AMT
				ELSE 0
				END
			) AS credit
		,HTD.TRAN_AMT AS tranAmt
		,HTD.PART_TRAN_TYPE AS partTrantype
		,EDF.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS ccy
		,CRM_ACCOUNTS.struserfield13 AS wealthTagging
	FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
	--LEFT JOIN PREV_DB AS PD
	--	ON RW.FULLDATE = PD.FULLDATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
		ON RW.FullDate = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		AND EDF.del_flg <> 'Y'
		AND EDF.GAM_SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA','SBA','TDA')
	LEFT JOIN eds.Customer_Dim AS CRM_ACCOUNTS ON CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
		--AND SUBSTRING(CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.CORE_CUST_ID = EDF.CUST_ID
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
		--AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_End_Date
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_End_Date = '9999-12-31'
	--LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM DD ON RW.FullDate = DD.FULLDATE
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF_PREV ON EDF.GAM_ACID = EDF_PREV.GAM_ACID
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDF_PREV.GAM_BANK_ID
		--AND DD.Previous_Business_Day = EDF_PREV.AS_OF_DATE 
		AND RW.FullDate = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		--AND PD.PREV_AOD = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		--AND PD.FORACID_UNMASKED = EDF.FORACID_UNMASKED
		AND EDF_PREV.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
	LEFT JOIN (
		select
		sum(COALESCE(DAC.LIEN_AMT,0)) AGG_LIENAMT
		,DAC.ACID
		,DAC.BANK_ID
		,DAC.SCD_START_DATE
		,DAC.SCD_END_DATE
		,DAC.LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN DAC
		WHERE	
			DAC.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
		AND DAC.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
		GROUP BY DAC.ACID
			,DAC.BANK_ID
			,DAC.SCD_START_DATE
			,DAC.SCD_END_DATE
			,DAC.LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE
		) DAC ON EDF.GAM_ACID = DAC.ACID
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = DAC.BANK_ID
		AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN DAC.SCD_START_DATE
			AND DAC.SCD_END_DATE

		AND (
			DAC.LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE IS NULL
			OR DAC.LIEN_EXPIRY_DATE < RW.FullDate
			)
	LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE HTD ON EDF.GAM_ACID = HTD.ACID
		--AND RW.FullDate = HTD.TRAN_DATE
		--AND HTD.TRAN_DATE BETWEEN DATEADD(DAY, 1, EOMONTH(RW.FULLDATE, -2)) AND EOMONTH(RW.FULLDATE, -1)
		AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = HTD.BANK_ID
		AND HTD.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
	WHERE	
		CRM_ACCOUNTS.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
		AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.struserfield13 IS NOT NULL
		AND HTD.TRAN_DATE IS NOT NULL;
GO
